title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Jurisdiction over Foreign-Related Civil and Commercial Cases

articles.content_en: Article 1 A Primary People's Court shall have jurisdiction over first instance foreign-related civil and commercial cases, except as otherwise provided by laws or judicial interpretations.

Article 2 An Intermediate People's Court shall have jurisdiction over the following first instance foreign-related civil and commercial cases:
(1) Foreign-related civil and commercial cases with a large subject matter amount in dispute.
An Intermediate People's Court in the jurisdictions of Beijing, Tianjin, Shanghai, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Fujian, Shandong, Guangdong, and Chongqing shall have jurisdiction over foreign-related civil and commercial cases with a subject matter amount of RMB 40 million or more (including the figure);
An Intermediate People's Court in the jurisdictions of Hebei, Shanxi, Inner Mongolia, Liaoning, Jilin, Heilongjiang, Anhui, Jiangxi, Henan, Hubei, Hunan, Guangxi, Hainan, Sichuan, Guizhou, Yunnan, Tibet, Shaanxi, Gansu, Qinghai, Ningxia, and Xinjiang, the Military Courts of the theater commands of the People's Liberation Army and the Military Court directly under the Central Military Commission, and the Intermediate People's Courts under the jurisdiction of the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region shall have jurisdiction over foreign-related civil and commercial cases with a subject matter amount of RMB 20 million or more (including the figure).
(2) Foreign-related civil and commercial cases with complex facts or a large number of parties on one side.
(3) Other foreign-related civil and commercial cases having a significant impact within the jurisdiction.
Where laws or judicial interpretations provide otherwise regarding the jurisdiction of an Intermediate People's Court over first instance foreign-related civil and commercial cases, such cases shall be handled in accordance with the relevant provisions.

Article 3 A Higher People's Court shall have jurisdiction over first instance foreign-related civil and commercial cases with a subject matter amount of RMB 5 billion or more (including the figure) or other cases having a significant impact within the jurisdiction.

Article 4 A Higher People's Court may, based on the actual circumstances of its jurisdiction and if it deems it truly necessary, and upon reporting to and obtaining approval from the Supreme People's Court, designate one or several Primary People's Courts or Intermediate People's Courts to exercise cross-regional centralized jurisdiction over the first instance foreign-related civil and commercial cases provided for in Articles 1 and 2 of these Provisions respectively.
Where cross-regional centralized jurisdiction is exercised in accordance with the preceding paragraph, the Higher People's Court shall promptly make public to the society the corresponding jurisdictional areas of the designated Primary People's Court or Intermediate People's Court.
Article 5 Foreign-related civil and commercial cases shall be heard by a specialized adjudication division or collegial panel.

Article 6 These Provisions shall not apply to foreign-related maritime and admiralty dispute cases, foreign-related intellectual property dispute cases, foreign-related ecological and environmental damage compensation dispute cases, and foreign-related environmental civil public interest litigation cases.

Article 7 These Provisions shall apply mutatis mutandis to civil and commercial cases involving the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the Macao Special Administrative Region, and the Taiwan region.
Article 8 These Provisions shall come into force as of January 1, 2023. Cases accepted after these Provisions come into force shall be governed by these Provisions.
Article 9 Where judicial interpretations previously issued by this Court are inconsistent with these Provisions, these Provisions shall prevail.
